items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-05
items.q: Sure, Fat used to come over there and sit in and play with us a lot of times.

ctx.x: Well, how did Fat Wallace know you? Fat used to come down here often.
Yeah, Fat used to come here to the Lyric Theater. When I was waiting for Beansy. Sure, Fat used to come over there and sit in and play with us a lot of times.

items.title: John Handy Interview, 1963-11-21
items.q: Oh yeah, I jam with him.

ctx.x: What about, uh, Fat Wallace? You ever know him? Sure, I know Fat. You play with him much? No.

Jam or anything? Oh yeah, I jam with him. Yeah. Oh yeah, I jam with him. When he coming out of the lyrics, the lyrics to you. Yeah, I jam with him. Did you ever get any offers from those guys? Yes, in my twenties I got a lot of offers. Who were some of the guys? Jimmy Lundford. I got offers from Jimmy. There's another guy named Boy, I can't think of his name now. He come to me directly. Yeah, well. And then late years you played a lot of grass band work on Hope too, wasn't it? Yeah, I played with, uh, but there…
